definition: to rub something smooth with sandpaper
description: A white-bearded man in a checked shirt stands on a wooden dock over a lake with a curly-haired boy, both gripping a fishing rod as a small fish comes up on the line. The scene cuts to a workshop close-up: a large weathered hand presses a folded sheet of sandpaper along the pitched roof of a half-finished wooden birdhouse, rubbing it back and forth while a child's hand holds the box steady. The man then stands at the workbench with five children around him, gesturing over the finished birdhouse. In the last shot two old men play chess at a low table in a park while children watch and kites fly overhead.

taps.target: the man in the checked shirt

taps.phrase: to flap on the wooden dock
